ground_truth.cause: ValidatingWebhookConfiguration pod-policy intercepts CREATE pods in shop with failurePolicy=Fail, but its platform-ops/pod-policy-webhook service is absent. Injection recreates recommendation, whose replacement is blocked by the unavailable webhook.
ground_truth.impact: New pod admissions in shop are affected, including recommendation and its downstream frontend path. Existing pods and unrelated namespaces are not automatically affected. This is not webhook-relay in batch.
ground_truth.mitigation: Restore the intended admission service and connectivity, or remove the specific broken test webhook as scoped containment. A temporary fail-open change must acknowledge its policy impact and rollback; do not disable all admission enforcement. Verify pod admission and recommendation/frontend recovery.

causal_change.reason: This scenario does not provide a controlled introducing commit and recorded product access to its history.
